newsitem.title: POLAND: Nearly half of Poles see yr/yr CPI around 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Nearly half of Poles see yr/yr CPI around 20 pct.

text.p: Some 49 percent of Poles surveyed by Centrum Badania Opinii Spolecznej (CBOS) in August expect year-on-year inflation in December 1996 to stay around 20 percent, CBOS said on Thursday.
In July, year-on-year inflation was 20.4 percent, down from 21.6 percent in December 1995.
About one-fourth of those polled said inflation would be above 25 percent this year, the public polling centre said.
The government has set the 1996 price growth target at 17 percent, but banks expect inflation to be 18.6 percent in December, according to a Reuter poll of Poland's largest banks.
CBOS said 11 percent thought the government's 17 percent consumer price growth target would be met this year.
